items.title: Database Patterns for Microservices
items.description: Transactional Outbox, Saga, CQRS, Event Sourcing, database-per-service, and data consistency patterns in distributed architectures.

items.title: Debit Posting
items.description: Deep-dive into core banking debit posting — ledger mechanics, memo vs. hard post, balance contention, idempotency, locking strategies, saga compensation, and production Java/Spring implementation patterns.

items.title: Debit Reversals — Ledger Accounting, ISO 8583/20022 Protocols & Distributed Sagas
items.description: Deep architectural guide to debit reversals in banking engines, double-entry immutable ledgers, ISO 8583 0400/0420 Store-and-Forward mechanisms, and distributed Saga compensation patterns.

items.title: Distributed Transactions: 2PC vs. Saga Pattern
items.description: Master guide to distributed transactions in microservices — Two-Phase Commit (2PC), Saga Pattern (Choreography vs. Orchestration), Transactional Outbox + CDC, and NewSQL architectures.

items.title: Saga Pattern (Distributed Workflows)
items.description: A comprehensive guide to the Saga Pattern — from core concepts for beginners to choreography vs orchestration internals, state machine design, idempotency, compensating transactions, temporal coupling, failure taxonomy, and production observability for senior engineers.

items.title: Serverless Architecture Patterns
items.description: Advanced Serverless Integration Patterns for DVA-C02 and Senior Engineering roles. Orchestration vs Choreography, Saga Pattern, and Strangler Fig.

items.title: Service Decomposition — DDD Bounded Contexts, Strangler Fig & Database Extraction
items.description: Principal engineering guide to microservice decomposition, Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Bounded Contexts, Strangler Fig migration, database decoupling, and distributed transaction strategies.
